title: Nan and the Tin Pan
lines: Nan sat at a tin pan.
Tap it, Nan! Tap, tap, tap!
Sam sat at a tan pan.
Pat it, Sam! Pat, pat, pat!
A man sat as Nan and Sam tap.
I am a fan! I am a pan fan!
Nan, Sam and the man tap!

questions.ask: What were Nan and Sam tapping on?
questions.listenFor: Pans, a tin one and a tan one. If your child says just pans, ask which pan was Nan's, and let them find the line.

questions.ask: What did the man say he was?
questions.listenFor: A fan - he liked the sound so much he said so out loud. This is a fun one to talk about, because a fan can mean two things.

questions.ask: What would you tap on to make a good sound? Tell me why that one.
questions.listenFor: Anything is a fine answer. You are listening for the reason, and it is a lovely chance to go tap on something together.
